text: Illustration. A different car, April 20th account
In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
observed: 15.0 to 15.2 s the wide creek shot continues: the car drifts left with a brown wake trailing to the right. At 15.4 s the framing moves closer: trees larger, distant buildings gone, ledge steps out of frame. The car tilts nose down, sinks to the windows and moves left 15.4 to 15.8 s with a trailing wake. In every frame a pale tan band runs straight and horizontal across the full width between the far bank and the darker brown water, with straight upper and lower boundaries. Caption holds.
